label: Applied AI engineering
tagline: Watch the GPU hours and API quota behind your experiments
opening: You've joined the applied AI team at **<<biz>>**, where experiments stall when GPU hours or API quota quietly run out. The team lead wants a program that watches the quota.
rule: The team rule: when a resource is down to **<<level>> or fewer** units, top it up before the next experiment fails halfway through.
scene: A teammate asks in chat: "How much <<n2>> do we have left?" Nobody should read the whole report. The program needs a quick lookup, and it must cope with resources you don't track.

action.name: spend
action.doc: use some of the quota and return how much is left

glossary: A small chunk of text a language model reads or writes. Usage is billed by tokens.
The amount of a resource you are allowed to use in a period.
One hour of a graphics processor, the chip that trains and runs models.
A list of numbers that captures the meaning of text, used for search and RAG.
Training an existing model further on your own data.
Running tests to measure how good a model's answers are.
What one unit of a resource costs. Multiply by usage to budget.
py_uses: Clean and label training data for models
Build RAG pipelines that answer questions from company documents
Track experiments, cost and quality across model runs
